name: Bernard
description:
Bernard is a series of animated shorts centered on the fictional polar bear and main character of the same name. It is a Korean-Spanish-French co-production. Each three-minute episode focuses on the bear's curiosity and have many moments of slapstick. Bernard never speaks with the exception of unintelligible noises

Bernard is accompanied in the cartoons by a few other characters: Lloyd and Eva the penguins, Zack the lizard, Goliat the chihuahua, Sam the baby, Pilot the dog, Pokey the porcupine and Santa Claus. He usually gets knocked unconscious or severely injured at the end of an episode, due to some calamity caused by his bumbling

videos.title: Mug Travel
videos.overview: Nominated for and winner of the award for The Best Film for Children, the CG film Mug Travel was produced by RG Animation Studios and is a wonderful film adaptation of the computer animated television Backkom Series [related A.I. news: ""Backkom" Goes International"]. Directed by Lim Ah-ron, Mug Travel follows the character Bebe, who lonely one Christmas Eve comes into possession of a magical pendant, which with the help of a strange mug that has the magical power of transportation, embarks upon a fantastical voyage. Bebe, a baby, explores everything from deserts to forests to valleys and much more. Creativity and originality follow Bebe and other characters Konkongee (penguin), Backkom (polar bear) and many more animals; many of these characters of which do more harm than help. Ultimately quite frustrating in their travels and annoying one another to no end, working together and adjusting to change are tackled with the unconventional humor and curios directorial strategies of Director Lim Ah-ron are at the forefront of Mug Travel.

videos.title: The Gym
videos.overview: Bernard goes to the gym and starts training enthusiastically... until he discovers that each piece of equipment has a life of its own

videos.title: Golf
videos.overview: Bernard goes to the gym and starts training enthusiastically... until he discovers that each piece of equipment has a life of its own

videos.title: The Swing
videos.overview: Bernard finds a beautiful tree with a beautiful swing. The only problem is that someone else has got there first!

videos.title: Security Guard
videos.overview: Bernard is very familiar with the exhibits in the museum where he works, so why is that moving sculpture carrying a canvas in its hand?

videos.title: The Vending Machine
videos.overview: Sportsmanship is about knowing how to win and how to lose... and sometimes about how to share a refreshing drink with your opponent after the game...

videos.title: Diving Board
videos.overview: Bernard desperately tries to copy all the things that Lloyd (the penguin) enjoys doing at the swimming pool... including diving from the highest springboard!

videos.title: Watching TV
videos.overview: Whatever the time, wherever he is, Bernard is completely hooked on television... that is until the shop closes and the shutters come down

videos.title: Hitchhiking
videos.overview: Picking up hitchhikers can often be very dangerous. So when Bernard stops to pick up Zack, he should remember that one day he may need a lift

videos.title: Sky Diving
videos.overview: If Bernard ever succeeds in jumping out of the plane, he's bound to forget his parachute. Is there any other way he would want to do it?

videos.title: At the Theme Park
videos.overview: Bernard just wants to have a good time at the theme park. The trouble is that someone else wants to be in his photo and then that balloon appears...

videos.title: A Day in the Country
videos.overview: Bernard has gone to the mountain, while the mountain comes to Bernard! It may look like rain, but Bernard's not worried because he's got his umbrella

videos.title: Learning to Fly
videos.overview: Bernard is learning to fly, and may not have chosen the best day... But once you are airborne, the important thing is not how you land, but where you land!

videos.title: Close Encounters
videos.overview: Bernard is delighted to receive a visit from a small extraterrestrial, but his visitor is less than delighted by Bernard's limited technological skills

videos.title: The Intruder
videos.overview: One night Bernard's supper is interrupted by an intruder. Can a lone polar bear deal with the darkness, his own deep-seated fears and... a little mouse?

videos.title: Basketball
videos.overview: There's nothing Bernard likes better than a challenge, and when it comes to playing basketball against Zack, winning means winning at all costs

videos.title: The Cart
videos.overview: What do you get when you cross a motor scooter with a supermarket cart? The answer - as Bernard finds out the hard way – is a highly dangerous vehicle

videos.title: Bowling
videos.overview: Bernard the bowling champ takes on Lloyd. It should be easy for Bernard, but in sport there are three kinds of luck – good luck, bad luck and... Bernard's luck

videos.title: Taekwondo
videos.overview: In order to recover his property from Zack, Bernard takes up taekwondo. He develops awesome skills, but the result is not quite what he had planned

videos.title: Scuba Diving
videos.overview: Bernard looks forward to a day's scuba diving. At first all goes swimmingly, but he soon realises that not everything is quite what it seems under the sea

videos.title: Doors
videos.overview: Most people can negotiate revolving doors, even when they have their arms full of packages. But Bernard is not quite like everyone else

videos.title: At the Museum
videos.overview: Museums contain thousands of priceless exhibits carefully preserved for hundreds of years. Then Bernard pays a visit...

videos.title: Street Racing
videos.overview: When Zack lines up alongside him at the traffic lights, it gives Bernard the perfect excuse to start a race through the city streets. But what about other road users?

videos.title: The Desert Island
videos.overview: Bernard finds himself on a desert island where all the inhabitants try to make him feel welcome... in their own special way

videos.title: Baseball
videos.overview: Bernard soon figures out how the baseball pitching machine works, until the machine steps up a gear and shows it has a few more tricks up its sleeve

videos.title: The Car
videos.overview: Bernard is proud of his small convertible. The only trouble is that he can't get everything in the boot, which complicates life more than you would imagine

videos.title: The Flower
videos.overview: Bernard loves his flower, and is determined to do whatever is necessary to protect it from danger – no matter what the cost

videos.title: The Medallion
videos.overview: Bernard finds a medallion, but soon discovers that it brings bad luck. So he tries to throw it away, but unfortunately for him, it keeps on coming back

videos.title: The Moth
videos.overview: When Bernard tries to get rid of an annoying moth, something unexpected happens and his kitchen becomes a very dangerous place

videos.title: Bullfighter
videos.overview: Bernard finds himself in field full of bulls, and despite his lack of experience, decides to try his hand at bull-fighting

videos.title: At the North Pole
videos.overview: Bernard gets bored trekking across the frozen Arctic wastes. Some abandoned equipment becomes a source of great entertainment, but not for long...

videos.title: The Package
videos.overview: Zack tries to steal a parcel which Bernard is carrying.  At first he succeeds, but Bernard doesn't give up that easily...

videos.title: Sleepwalker
videos.overview: Even when he's asleep, Bernard is capable of anything – as he finds out when he wakes up in the morning

videos.title: The Pizza
videos.overview: Bernard has to deliver a pizza to a haunted house... and to its starving owner. But how is he going to get paid?

videos.title: The Unicycle
videos.overview: To the amazement of Zack, Bernard discovers he has some performing skills which he never knew he had

videos.title: The Motorboat
videos.overview: Although Bernard has been shipwrecked, his real problems begin when he finds an abandoned motorboat which could get him back to shore

videos.title: The Prisoner
videos.overview: Bernard makes a daring escape from prison, but once he's out, he realises that perhaps life inside wasn't so bad after all

videos.title: The Supermarket
videos.overview: Bernard is delighted with all the bargains he has bought. Now the only problem is how to get them all home

videos.title: The Mosquito
videos.overview: Bernard feels very tired and wants to sleep for hours... But there's a mosquito about with other ideas. He just has to get rid of that mosquito

videos.title: Oasis
videos.overview: In the middle of the desert Bernard stumbles across an oasis. The palm trees look real enough, and that cool water is just too tempting

videos.title: The Treasure
videos.overview: A map may lead you to the hidden treasure, but does not always tell you about the hidden dangers... Even Indiana Jones would have had trouble here

videos.title: The Window Cleaner
videos.overview: Bernard is cleaning the windows of a skyscraper, when he disturbs two birds trying to protect their fledgling

videos.title: Marathon
videos.overview: Bernard, Zack and Lloyd are competing in a marathon. The winner will not be the one who runs the fastest, but the one who survives the longest

videos.title: The Fumigator
videos.overview: Do you like cockroaches? No? Well, nor does Bernard, and he is determined to get them out of his house somehow

videos.title: The Fumigator 2
videos.overview: Despite all Bernard's efforts, the cockroaches are taking over Bernard's house, but his patience is running out

videos.title: Close Encounters 2
videos.overview: Another UFO appears on Bernard's radar. He is desperate to see what is inside the strange carapace, but the extraterrestrial is in no hurry to show himself

videos.title: The Little Dog
videos.overview: Goliath may be tiny but he packs a charge of aggression and bad temper equivalent to someone several times his size... as Bernard discovers

videos.title: A Lucky Day
videos.overview:
Is it really possible for our walking disaster of a polar bear to have a lucky day?

Bernard... lucky... for a whole day?

videos.overview: Once Bernard had a polar home on the ice cap, but a lightning strike during a polar thunderstorm forces him to leave it all behind

videos.title: The Vacuum Cleaner
videos.overview: When the vacuum cleaner finishes its work, there's not a speck of dust anywhere, and no sign of Bernard's winning lottery ticket either!
